volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…+12 dB). 0 dB is unity. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

method.tooltip: Polynomial = exact joint sin/cos (default). Wavetable = additive’s half-sine LUT (2¹⁵) for lower CPU.

phase.tooltip: Phase offset (cycles). Knob + Phase jack + Phase MOD from audio-rate sources all add sample-accurately.

freq.tooltip: Hz. Parameter MOD is domain-add (base + CV). Set base 0 and wire Pitch Detector / Knob Bias for absolute Hz. Enable Bipolar in param settings for thru-zero FM (negative Hz = reverse phase).

frequency.tooltip: Default slider 0…20 kHz. Pitch MOD can run down through 0. Thru-zero: enable Bipolar on Frequency (domain-add MOD). Domain min/max are slider guides.

morph.tooltip: 0…1 width/duty. 0.5 = center (triangle / 50% PWM). Trisaw & Pulse / Center Square only. Modulate via the Morph param-row MOD jack.

amplitude.tooltip: Output level. Slider 0…1 = full-scale bipolar wave. Min/max are guides only — type large values for gain past unity (domain not hard-clamped).

method.tooltip: Polynomial = exact joint sin/cos (default). Wavetable = additive’s half-sine LUT (2¹⁵) for lower CPU.

phase.tooltip: Phase offset (cycles). Knob + Phase jack + Phase MOD from audio-rate sources all add sample-accurately.

freq.tooltip: Hz. Parameter MOD is domain-add (base + CV). Set base 0 and wire Pitch Detector / Knob Bias for absolute Hz. Enable Bipolar in param settings for thru-zero FM (negative Hz = reverse phase).

bpm.tooltip: Tempo in beats per minute. Also writes the patch Master Clock BPM.

pulseWidth.tooltip: Gate high duty of each cycle (0..1). 0.5 = square. Affects Gate 0-1 / Gate -1+1.

timeNumerator.tooltip: Numerator of Numer/Denom × whole note (same as Ping Pong). Numer=0 → no clock. 1/4 = one beat at BPM.

timeDenominator.tooltip: Denominator of Numer/Denom × whole note. At Numer=1: Denom 4=¼, 8=⅛, 16=1/16, 32=1/32.

timingMode.tooltip: Normal = Numer/Denom as written. Dotted = 1.5×. Triplet = 2/3× (three fit in two normals).

amplitude.tooltip: Output level for gate and trigger outs.

mode.tooltip: Lin = clamp Env to 0…1. Exp = classic VCA CV law (quiet lows, unity at 1) for Amplitude params.

velocitySensitivity.tooltip: SoEm VelocitySensitivity. 0 = ignore Velocity (peak 1); 1 = peak tracks Velocity.

attack.tooltip: SoEm Attack → attackFeedback time. 0 = skip attack into decay.

decaySlopeMid.tooltip: SoEm DecaySlopeMid → decay_ base added into decay feedback.

sustain.tooltip: SoEm Sustain → endingDecay after the decay phasor finishes.

autoReleaseTime.tooltip: SoEm AutoReleaseTime (displayed as ms; 0 = disabled). Same as original: Enabled {n} ms.
